about_the_game:
The Eydigard Supporter's Pack is a special collection designed for players who want to go beyond the base game and show extra support for Frostisen Studio, a small, independent team dedicated to bringing the rich folklore and wild landscapes of Northern Norway to life.

As a heartfelt thank-you, we’ve prepared unique bonus content for supporters:

  • Digital Artbook – A carefully curated collection of concept art, sketches, character designs, and beautiful landscapes from Eydigard. Explore our artistic journey from initial ideas to the finished game.

  • Exclusive Lynx Skin – A unique color variant for your lynx form, available only to supporters.

This Supporter's Pack isn't required to fully enjoy Eydigard—but your purchase directly contributes to our studio’s ongoing efforts, enabling us to keep expanding and improving the game we love creating.

Thanks for believing in Eydigard, and in us.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (2.7 GHz 4 Core) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or equivalent
